notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware run. This package serves NavigationTrack-v0 (native gym_navigation.envs.navigation_track:NavigationTrack); the sibling NavigationGoal-v0 is registered upstream but is not served. gymnasium, numpy and pygame were not importable where the gate ran (requirements.txt:1-3), so fake.py is the package's own pure Python restatement of track 1 (geometry, five-ray scan, Gaussian noise, rewards) and was not compared with the upstream environment; the sim backend (gymnasium.make('NavigationTrack-v0')) was not run. The fake models track 1 only. Two warnings are expected for this family: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset, so it makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the integer inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.index and seed twice). Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
